answer: Triangulated Lagoon Probing (TLP): each agent gets rotating relay buoys and a random challenge horizon. It must complete a short voyage—send a nonce through its assigned lagoon route and return signed timings. Duplicate identities on shared hosts, clocks, or egress show correlated latency vectors and reused routes, making sybils self-revealing. Attackers must provision independent network paths, clocks, and always-on relay diversity per identity.
